name: Fuse AI
long_description:
FuseAI is the AI-native sales platform for modern revenue teams.

Built for high-performance outbound, FuseAI consolidates your entire GTM stack - data, enrichment, multi-channel automation, real-time buying signals, and AI-driven execution  into one seamless system.

With powerful integrations and intelligent workflows, FuseAI doesn’t just help you run campaigns. It turns every signal into pipeline, and every rep into a top performer.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: At 17, Imogen joined SAP’s Innovation team as a MLE after teaching herself to code and earning international recognition for her indoor navigation app. She later led NLP and ML initiatives across Asia Pacific at SAP before co-founding NWO.ai in New York at 21. Later, NWO.ai was acquired by Growth Protocol.

launches.title: FuseAI - Agentic Sales Platform
launches.tagline: We’re killing legacy sales software with AI agents - RIP Salesforce & ZoomInfo. 🦖🦖
launches.body:
**TL;DR – [FuseAI](https://tryfuse.ai/) is an agentic sales platform that enables B2B companies to simplify their tech stacks and empowers 1 sales professional to complete the work of 5.** \
\
▶️ [**Try FuseAI today**](https://tryfuse.ai/) ◀️

Here’s a [preview of what we’re building at FuseAI](https://youtu.be/nPVwCphuZAI)

### **The Problem**

Nowadays, go-to-market teams struggle with manual tasks and fragmented data due to the 10+ disconnected sales tools they are operating on. Legacy software evolved this way primarily because incumbents focused on becoming hyper-specialized with point solutions to accommodate for system of record providers such as Salesforce & Hubspot and the inability to interact with data efficiently until AI had tangible commercial application in 2023. The advent of LLMs is enabling a paradigm shift in the industry with a small window, but massive opportunity, to disrupt incumbents with legacy infrastructure.

### **Our Solution**

Our product can be best described as an agentic sales platform – think Salesforce meets OpenAI operator with the ability to complete any workflow imaginable through simple natural language prompts. The first agents in production enable users to complete the following through simple natural language prompts:

* Automatically create targeted lead lists
* Conduct market research on prospects
* Automatically create & manage opportunity pipeline
* Engage with clients across LinkedIn and email

### **Our Mission**

Our mission is simple - make the best companies and sales professionals 5X better and build a platform that everyone actually enjoys using. We're building for user experience and productivity, so your best reps can close $5M in deals annually vs. the traditional $1M target for SaaS companies. We've started with outbound sales but will be expanding to other GTM verticals across inbound sales, revenue operations, account management, and marketing. As we expand our AI agents across GTM operations roles, our platform will drive significant savings for companies without the need to have huge support functions for roles such as: technical systems analysts, revenue operations professionals, and deal desk analysts, with most of their redundant activities automated. The total market opportunity is 1+ trillion for developing a new type of software interface embedded with vertical AI agents to both streamline existing workflows and drive savings from FTE reductions.

### **How We Got Here**

We started [FuseAI](https://tryfuse.ai/) out of Saurav’s frustration at Deel - despite being one of the most successful companies of all time, they still struggled immensely with legacy sales software, creating inefficient manual workflows across the go-to-market organization. With the vast improvement in LLMs and agentic applications - Saurav and Imogen realized it was the perfect time to build a new operating system to disrupt legacy incumbents in the industry and took the plunge to start building the future of go-to-market at [FuseAI](https://tryfuse.ai/).

### **Use FuseAI**

You can get started today by joining the [waitlist or booking a demo](https://tryfuse.ai/) with the team today. Sales professionals from around the world use [FuseAI](https://tryfuse.ai/) to automatically create lead lists, engage with clients, deanonymize website traffic, and manage their deal cycles.

### **Asks**

* **Try FuseAI** out and reach out to us with your feedback and questions. We love when people send us screen recordings, written feedback, and ideas. Email Saurav - [saurav@tryfuse.ai](mailto:saurav@tryfuse.ai)
* **Contribute** – Help us build the future of AI agents in go-to-market! We have an active community of contributors from all over the world who recommend agents and collaborate on agents to build, feel free to reach out to [saurav@tryfuse.ai](mailto:saurav@tryfuse.ai) to learn more
* **Follow us** – We put out a lot of content in a lot of places:
  * Follow [FuseAI on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/tryfuseai/?viewAsMember=true)
  * Follow FuseAI on [X](https://x.com/fuseai23129?s=21&t=U8uO3G_ueNJiXtFN1o0qFg)

### **About Us**

FuseAI is founded by [Saurav Bubber](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sauravbubber/), a seasoned operator, most recently supporting Deel's hyper-growth through $650M, and [Imogen Low](https://www.linkedin.com/in/imogen-low/), a machine learning engineer who joined SAP’s Innovation team at 17, and later co-founded [Nwo.ai](http://Nwo.ai) at 21 - a venture-backed AI startup acquired by Growth Protocol.
